text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them highly organised. To retrieve information, you use queries written in a special language. Good data modelling helps you plan the structure of your database before you build it, ensuring everything fits together logically. Indexes are another useful feature because they speed up searches, especially in large tables. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, offer more flexibility for unstructured data. Choosing the right type depends on your project's needs.
